missing_methods.intent: Verify edit feedback screen is displayed
missing_methods.query: Verify edit feedback screen is displayed
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: This method should verify that the edit feedback screen is displayed by checking for the presence of key elements that uniquely identify the feedback editing interface. It should wait for the feedback slide title element to be visible, verify the presence of the feedback text edit field, and confirm that the screen is in an editable state. The method should return True if all verification checks pass, False otherwise. It should use appropriate timeout values to handle page load delays and should raise an exception if the screen is not displayed within the expected timeframe.

missing_methods.intent: Assert tell your experience text is truncated to maximum characters
missing_methods.query: Assert tell your experience text is truncated to maximum characters
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: This method should verify that the tell your experience text input field enforces a maximum character limit by truncating input that exceeds the limit. It should: 1) Get the current text value from the feedback text field using get_entered_text() or similar method, 2) Get the character count display using get_feedback_text_char_count() to verify the count matches the actual text length, 3) Compare the length of the entered text against the expected_max_chars parameter, 4) Assert that the text length does not exceed the maximum allowed characters, 5) Optionally verify that the character count indicator shows the correct format (e.g., 'X/Y characters'), 6) Return True if the text is properly truncated to the maximum length, False otherwise. The method should handle edge cases where the text might be exactly at the limit or below it.
